metadata.title: The Club
metadata.description: Liverpool FC — 20 league titles, 6 European Cups. Explore the history, stadium, legends, traditions and more.

hero.foundingStory: Liverpool FC was born from a bitter dispute. In 1892, Everton FC left Anfield over a rent disagreement with their landlord John Houlding. Left with a stadium but no team, Houlding founded Liverpool Football Club on 15 March 1892. The club was admitted to the Football League the following year and won their first league title in 1901. What began as one man's determination to fill an empty stadium has grown into one of the most successful and beloved football clubs in the world.
hero.tagline: Since 1892 — 20 league titles, 6 European Cups and one Anfield.

whatIs.title: What is this site?
whatIs.description: LFCVN started with a simple idea: create a place where Vietnamese Liverpool fans can follow everything about the club they love — in their own language. Built by fans, for fans, LFCVN brings together match data, bilingual news, club history, and an AI assistant in one platform. You'll Never Walk Alone.

features.squad: Full squad and player profiles with season stats and form
features.season: Season dashboard with fixtures, PL & UCL standings, top scorers & assists charts
features.fixtures: Match timeline across 4 competitions — Premier League, Champions League, FA Cup, EFL Cup
features.news: News from 17+ sources in English & Vietnamese with smart categorisation and in-app reading
features.history: Club heritage — Anfield stadium, trophy cabinet, historical timeline, legends & managers
features.profile: Personal account with avatar, favourite players, and saved preferences
features.ai: LiverBird AI — ask about match results, player stats, transfer rumours, club history & more
features.i18n: Full bilingual support — English & Vietnamese with automatic locale detection

whatIs.dataSources: Fantasy Premier League API · Football-Data.org · ESPN · RSS feeds from BBC, Guardian, This Is Anfield, Liverpool Echo, Sky Sports, Anfield Watch, and Vietnamese outlets (Bóng Đá, 24h). Content enriched with Mozilla Readability.
whatIs.techStack: Next.js 16 (App Router, ISR) · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS 4 · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion · Recharts · Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + Storage) · next-intl (EN/VI)

metadata.title: Legal
metadata.description: Legal information, privacy policy, and terms of use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: LFCVN is an independent project and is not affiliated with Liverpool Football Club or Fenway Sports Group. We do not collect personal data beyond what is necessary for account functionality (email, username, avatar). Authentication is handled securely via Supabase. AI chat conversations are stored for continuity but are not shared externally. Gallery images are hosted on Cloudinary. We do not sell or share your data with third parties.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content: This site is provided as-is for informational and entertainment purposes only. All Liverpool FC trademarks, logos, and brand elements are the property of Liverpool Football Club and Athletic Grounds Limited. Match data is sourced from Football-Data.org and ESPN. News content is aggregated from 17+ RSS sources in English and Vietnamese. AI features (chat, translation, daily digest) are powered by VietAPI, with Groq for live web search. Use of this site constitutes acceptance of these terms.

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.content: League standings, fixtures, and squad data are provided by Football-Data.org. Cup fixtures and match events are supplemented by ESPN. News articles are aggregated from 17+ RSS feeds — English sources include LFC Official, BBC Sport, The Guardian, Liverpool Echo, Sky Sports, Anfield Watch, Empire of the Kop, and GOAL; Vietnamese sources include VnExpress, Tuổi Trẻ, Thanh Niên, Dân Trí, ZNews, VietNamNet, Bóng Đá, 24h, and Webthethao. AI chat, article translation and the daily digest are powered by VietAPI; live web search in chat uses Groq. Gallery images are hosted on Cloudinary. Historical data and trophy information are maintained by the site administrators based on publicly available records.
